versions.localizedDescription:
- Long Stay (from rebirth 8): look after a patient for a few days, one visit a day. Ten patients, and every stay is different
- Gifts: buy them in the Store, give one a day to your Long Stay patient, or send one to a friend
- Ward Rounds: three daily tasks, a weekly goal and seasonal events
- The Bag: keep boosts, Rebirth Passes and Licence Renewals for when you want them
- New Store offers, a daily sale, and bonuses for trading in the exchanges
- New minigames: Germ Run, Syringe Spin, Supply Sort, Cell Roll and Spot On
- Lose three minigames in a row and your licence is revoked for an hour (a renewal gets you back to work)
- Halloween and winter: patient costumes, a Halloween medkit and seasonal rewards
- Tap colours, medkit plates and two new free backgrounds
- Smoother minigames and a smoother Gloocose
- Lots of small art fixes
- Removed Herobrine
